config.prompt: Write a short story about a lighthouse keeper who finds a message in a bottle.

reference.text:
A message that changes everything.
The lighthouse stood tall and proud on the rocky coast, its beam slicing through the darkness like a shining sword. Keeper James had lived in the tower for nigh on 20 years, watching the sea and the world go by from his solitary perch. He knew every wave, every tide, every storm that came and went. He knew the sea like the back of his hand.
But on this particular evening, as the sun dipped below the horizon, James noticed something peculiar. A bottle, half-buried in the sand, caught his eye. He picked it up, blowing off the grains of sand that clung to it. The bottle was old, the glass worn and cloudy, but the cork was still intact. James carefully removed it, and a piece of paper slipped out.

He unfolded the paper, and his eyes widened as he read the message scrawled on it. "Dear Lighthouse Keeper," it began, "I am writing to you from a ship that has been lost at sea for over a century. We were on a voyage to the New World, but a storm drove us off course, and we were wrecked on these very rocks. I am the only survivor, and I have been living on this island
